_key.description: SHA-256 hash of the two Ensembl gene IDs together with the supporting PubMed IDs.

_from.description: Handle of one gene in the genetic interaction.

_to.description: Handle of the other gene in the genetic interaction.

detection_method.description: PSI-MI detection method. This adapter only loads genetic interference.

detection_method_code.description: PSI-MI identifier of that detection method.

interaction_type.description: BioGRID genetic-interaction classes for the pair, looked up from the PSI-MI ontology.

interaction_type_code.description: PSI-MI identifiers of those genetic-interaction classes.

confidence_value_biogrid.description: BioGRID confidence score from the merged table. Null when the source has none. Larger values mean higher reported confidence.

confidence_value_intact.description: IntAct MIscore from the merged table, on a 0–1 scale. Null when the source has none. Larger values mean more supporting evidence.

pmids.description: PubMed pages cited as evidence for this interaction.

z_score.description: Placeholder value of 0 so this collection can share a z_score index with COXPRESdb. Not a coexpression score.

molecular_function.description: Gene Ontology term for protein binding, as a handle into ontology_terms.
